scripts.cloud:up: cd ../server && PATH="$HOME/.orbstack/bin:$PATH" FEATHER_TRUST_PROXY=true FEATHER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:8431 docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.cloud:app: VITE_FEATHER_CLOUD_URL=http://localhost:8420 vite build --outDir dist-cloud --emptyOutDir && vite preview --outDir dist-cloud --port 8431 --strictPort
scripts.cloud:code: cd ../server && PATH="$HOME/.orbstack/bin:$PATH" docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml logs --no-log-prefix server | grep 'mail to' | tail -1
scripts.cloud:down: cd ../server && PATH="$HOME/.orbstack/bin:$PATH" docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml down
